overview.one_line: Built an Android application that fetches and displays movie information using the TMDB API with a clean mobile interface.
overview.summary: Movie Recommendation App is one of my earliest Android development projects and served as my first complete mobile application. Built using Kotlin and Android XML, the application retrieves movie information from the TMDB API and displays movie posters, titles, and descriptions in a scrollable mobile interface. The project provided hands-on experience with Android development, API integration, mobile UI design, and asynchronous data handling.
overview.elevator_pitch: An Android movie browsing application that integrates with the TMDB API to display movies, posters, and descriptions through a simple mobile interface.

problem.statement: Users often need a simple way to discover movies and view basic information without manually searching across multiple websites.
problem.why_it_matters: Mobile applications can provide a more convenient and engaging experience for browsing entertainment content.

motivation.why_i_built_it: The project was developed as part of a Summer Internship Certification program conducted by Imarticus Learning. It served as the capstone project required to complete the certification and earn academic credits.
motivation.personal_interest: As my first major Android application, the project allowed me to learn Android development, API integration, mobile UI design, and application architecture from scratch.

architecture.v1: The application was designed as a simple Android client that retrieves movie information from the TMDB API and displays it within a mobile interface.
architecture.current: The Android application sends requests to the TMDB API, retrieves movie metadata including posters and descriptions, processes the API responses, and displays the results within a scrollable user interface built using Android XML layouts. Kotlin is used for application logic, API communication, and data handling.
architecture.future: Future versions could introduce personalized recommendations, search functionality, watchlists, user accounts, movie ratings, and advanced filtering capabilities.

implementation_journey.initial_approach: The project started as a learning exercise during an Android development certification program and focused on understanding mobile application fundamentals.
major_milestones: Packaged the application as an installable APK.
key_decisions: Use TMDB API instead of creating a custom dataset.
Focus on learning Android development fundamentals.
Keep the application architecture simple and maintainable.
architecture_changes: Static UI Screens → API Driven Content

challenges.solution: Focused on Android Studio fundamentals, layouts, activities, and API integration.
challenges.lesson: Building complete applications accelerates learning more effectively than tutorials alone.

challenges.solution: Learned API request handling, response parsing, and dynamic content rendering.
challenges.lesson: API integration is a core skill for modern application development.
